manifest_binding.digest_rule: Each digest is lowercase SHA-256 of RFC-8785 JCS for the named mapping after removing only that mapping's schema_sha256 field. PR1 must commit the calculated values in both this package reconciliation and the delivery manifest; runtime verification recomputes and equality-checks them. No schema digest is supplied by workflow input or a comment body.
manifest_binding.executable_chain: The seven contract digests are shared definitions, API envelope, and five body schemas. Every body schema resolves its #/$defs references from the exact shared definitions mapping. The PR2-review, authority, and binder-review bodies bind the exact delivery manifest through executable_digests.manifest_sha256; that manifest carries all seven values. Runtime recomputes all seven before body validation, then compares the body-bound manifest hash. No leaf schema embeds its own digest.

raw_body_contract.exactness: The API body string must byte-equal RFC-8785 JCS of the parsed object. Leading or trailing whitespace, a final newline, Unicode normalization, or any other byte transformation is forbidden. SHA-256 is calculated over the exact UTF-8 bytes returned in the fetched API body field after the response is received.
raw_body_contract.parsing: A duplicate-key-detecting UTF-8 JSON parser must reject duplicate object member names before ordinary JSON parsing. Non-finite numbers, invalid Unicode/control characters, unknown keys, and values outside the closed schemas fail closed.
raw_body_contract.digest_recomputation: PR1 tests and the exact-revision review independently recompute the prepared tuple plus the shared-definitions, API-envelope, and five body-schema digests in two independent RFC-8785 implementations: one ECMAScript runtime and one Python runtime. All sixteen results (eight mappings times two runtimes) must equal each other and the committed values. The implementations reject integers outside the inclusive ECMAScript safe-integer range before canonicalization.
raw_body_contract.self_reference_rule: No record body contains its own comment ID, URL, raw-body digest, created_at, updated_at, publisher, or author_association. Those values exist only in the API envelope after creation. A body may reference only already-created earlier records by URL and raw-body digest.

shared_definitions.compilation_rule: For each body validator, construct one in-memory JSON Schema root with $schema equal to https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema, $defs equal to this mapping after removing schema_sha256 and compilation_rule, and the selected body mapping after removing schema_id and schema_sha256. No other definition or keyword is injected. Schema compilation failure blocks delivery.

api_envelope_schema.extraction_rule: This is the exact closed projection consumed from the GitHub response, not a claim that the upstream response has no other documented members. Map API id to comment_id, issue_url directly, user.id to publisher.numeric_id, and body byte length/digest to the calculated fields; then validate this projection. Require status 200, JSON content type, no redirect, canonical API host/repository/comment ID, exact issue_url equality, and html_url equality to the dispatch input. Parse the URL suffix as unsigned decimal and require exact numeric equality to comment_id and the inclusive 1..9007199254740991 safe-integer range before either RFC-8785 implementation.
api_envelope_schema.issuance_rule: For ACT-04 only, this fetched immutable created_at is the sole issuance time. No issued_at member exists in the ACT-04 body or any other record body.

cross_record_rules: Validate all five fetched API envelopes, raw-body/JCS contracts, and selected closed body schemas independently. The separately fetched VOC-085 settings- authority record must match the fifth schema and its immutable trusted envelope, exact URL, byte length, and raw-body digest must equal ACT03.settings_authority.evidence. Body schema IDs must be pairwise the five constants above. No fetched text is evaluated as instructions.

Require API created_at == updated_at for all five comments. Require the VOC-085 settings-authority.created_at < effective ACT03.created_at < PR2.merged_at < PR2-review.created_at < authority.created_at < binder-review.created_at < current-run.created_at. Equality fails closed. For token replacement, require a new settings-authority.created_at < replacement-ACT03.created_at, a new distinct token, the exact current existing-environment pre-state, and only CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN value mutation; no other setting may change. No executable previous-record reference or recursive historical fetch is permitted. Deep-exact compare settings-authority.authorized_settings_operator to ACT03.actor and compare operation, PR1, environment, phase4_token, rollback, and tuple_binding between those bodies. Require settings-authority.expires_at > PR2.merged_at, settings-authority.created_at < settings-authority.expires_at <= phase4_token.expires_at, all eight drift-invalidates constants in exact order, and exact one-use nonce/max-action semantics; expired or drifted authority cannot authorize ACT03 or PR2.

Authority API created_at is the sole issuance time. The authority body contains no issued_at. Exhaustively require authority.created_at < actual authority.body.expires_at <= min(authority.created_at + 30 minutes, effective ACT03.phase4_token.expires_at). Require both live-check server Date values and their captured local completion instants strictly before the earlier deadline.

Treat effective ACT03.phase4_token.expires_at as a second independent hard deadline. Require effective ACT03.created_at, PR2.merged_at, PR2-review.created_at, authority.created_at, binder-review.created_at, current-run.created_at, both live-check GitHub server Date values, both captured local completion instants, every required check-run started_at/completed_at, and the first secret-bearing step start instant all strictly before it. The first secret-bearing step records runner UTC before its first command reads a secret and rechecks both token and ACT-04 deadlines. If the token expires while PR2 is open, stop: a new exact VOC-085 settings-authority comment and replacement ACT03 record must precede the eventual PR2 merge and authorize only the API-token secret replacement. If expiry occurs after PR2 merge, that exact PR2 transition is stale and no replacement is constructible inside this two-PR package; stop for a newly governed correction. Never silently reissue or replace a token, and preserve ACT-05 immediate revocation.

Compare every later record_reference URL/digest to the already-fetched earlier envelope html_url/raw_body_sha256. Compare PR2, executable_digests, tuple_binding, and staging_assertions for deep exact equality across every body where present and to independently fetched repository/Cloudflare evidence.

Require the five accountable/operator/reviewer actor IDs and their five actor.provenance.session_reference values to be pairwise distinct, each role to match its record schema, each assignment revision to equal the reviewed PR1 or PR2 SHA applicable to that role, and every non-authorship flag to be true. GitHub publisher equality authenticates only the relay account and never satisfies actor separation.

hosted_checks must be sorted ascending by name using Unicode code-point order, have the exact names `ci required`, `security required`, and `structure`, and deep-equal the required projection from the bounded check-runs response for PR2 merge SHA. Every projected head_sha equals that merge SHA, app ID/slug equal 15368/github-actions, status equals completed, and conclusion equals success. Every normalized decimal run/suite ID is in 1..9007199254740991 and every selected timestamp is inside the immutable PR2-merge-to-review-envelope cutoff window. Any missing, duplicate, extra-body, pending, stale, greatest-time-tied, or paginated required evidence fails. Unrelated endpoint names are ignored as specified below. Parse the workflow run and job suffixes from each selected check details_url and parse the decimal suffixes from workflow_run.url and workflow_run.html_url. Require all three run suffixes to be canonical safe decimals and exactly equal normalized workflow_run.id; require the details job suffix to be a canonical safe decimal exactly equal to check_run_id; and require check_run.check_suite_id to exactly equal workflow_run.check_suite_id. Then require a unique deep-equal workflow_run projection from the event-filtered push-run response. Require exact check-name -> workflow-name/path/ID mapping: `ci required` -> `CI` / `.github/workflows/ci.yml` / `321329558`; `security required` -> `Security` / `.github/workflows/security.yml` / `337617927`; and `structure` -> `Governance` / `.github/workflows/governance.yml` / `337617928`. Require event push, head branch develop, exact PR2 merge head SHA, completed/success, run_attempt 1, safe run ID, canonical API/HTML URLs, and exact workflow/check-run check_suite_id equality. A canonical URL whose run/job suffix differs from its projected ID fails closed. Require PR2.merged_at <= workflow.created_at <= workflow.run_started_at <= check.started_at <= check.completed_at <= workflow.updated_at < PR2-review.created_at. Any selected or body-recorded workflow_dispatch or other-event run fails; unrelated non-push candidates cannot satisfy selection.

All four dispatch URL/digest inputs must equal their fetched envelopes. The nonce input must equal authority.body.nonce. No API envelope metadata or digest may be taken from a body, and no body-selected timestamp may extend authority.

live_http_contract.settings_authority_comment_rule: Derive the fifth comment ID only from the already validated ACT03 body reference, require its URL to be canonical issue #158, fetch it exactly once, build the same closed API-envelope projection, and require trusted publisher, created_at == updated_at, exact URL/raw-body digest equality, exact JCS bytes, and the closed settings-authority body schema. Never treat ACT03 as its own settings authority.

check_runs_response_projection.exactness: Require status 200, JSON content type, no redirect, `total_count` equal to the check_runs array length and at most 100, no Link header with rel="next", and no second page. `filter=all` is explicit. Ignore unrelated names. For each of the three committed required names and only GitHub Actions app ID 15368/slug github-actions, parse the details URL's run/job suffixes as canonical safe decimals, require job suffix equality to check_run_id, and first require run suffix and check_suite_id membership in the validated exact push-workflow-run response; nonmember checks, including workflow_dispatch, are ineligible and ignored. Then form the closed review window PR2.merged_at <= started_at <= completed_at < PR2-review envelope.created_at. Ignore a candidate whose non-null started_at is at or after the cutoff and exclude any candidate whose canonical details URL names the already fetched current workflow run ID. Reject an eligible push queued/in_progress candidate that cannot be proven post-cutoff, and reject any run that starts before but completes at/after the cutoff. Among eligible completed candidates, select the unique candidate with greatest non-null completed_at; an absent candidate or greatest-time tie fails. Reject a selected non-matching head_sha, unsafe/malformed run or suite ID, non-completed/non-success result, null/inverted timestamp or noncanonical URL, or completion after the effective Phase-4 token expiry. Sort the three selected projections and require deep exact equality with the PR2-review body. Unrelated check names are not hosted evidence and neither authorize nor block this committed required projection. A review-body check naming an ignored/non-push run or carrying any canonical but unequal details run/job/check ID is an extra/mismatch and fails exact equality.
check_runs_response_projection.committed_source: The names are derived from the job `name` fields and push-to-develop triggers committed in PR1's exact `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `governance.yml`, and `security.yml`. Governance `changed-path risk` and `merge eligibility` and all Quality jobs are pull_request-only and therefore cannot exist on PR2 merge SHA; PR2 must have passed its separate pre-merge checks before merge.

push_workflow_runs_response_projection.exactness: Require status 200, JSON content type, no redirect, total_count equal to array length and exactly 3, no Link header with rel="next", and no second page. The three workflow run IDs, check-suite IDs, workflow IDs, names, paths, API URLs, and HTML URLs must be unique, canonical, and safe. Require the three exact committed workflow tuples above, event push, head_branch develop, exact PR2 merge head_sha, completed/success, run_attempt 1, and non-null ordered timestamps wholly inside the PR2-merge-to-review cutoff. Parse each workflow API/HTML URL suffix as a canonical safe decimal and require both to equal the normalized workflow-run ID. Parse the run/job suffixes from each selected check-run details_url and require run equality to that same workflow ID, job equality to check_run_id, and exact check/workflow check_suite_id equality. Then require a unique matching workflow run with exact name/path/ID mapping. Any missing, duplicate, extra, paginated, stale, non-push, wrong-attempt, or canonical-but-mismatched URL/run/job/check/suite ID blocks before secrets.

live_http_contract.remaining_budget_rule: The `/rate_limit` preflight is one HTTP request but consumes zero core requests. Before the first pass, its `resources.core.remaining` must be at least 40; immediately before the second pass, it must be at least 20. Each pass has at most 21 HTTP requests and at most 20 core requests because prior-run scanning stops when its bounded cutoff is proven. Every response's GitHub Date and rate-limit headers must parse consistently. A missing header, lower remaining value, 403/429, fifth-comment mismatch, check-runs or push-runs extra page/count mismatch, 1,000-result boundary, or any request beyond the allocation blocks before secrets. No retry occurs inside either pass.

authority_construction_rule.acceptance: Fetch a successful canonical GitHub API response immediately before building the authority body. Set body expires_at to that response's server Date plus exactly 25 minutes and start the one create-comment request within the same bounded script. After creation, fetch the comment and require preflight Date <= API created_at <= preflight Date + 60 seconds and created_at < actual expires_at <= min(created_at + 30 minutes, effective ACT03.phase4_token.expires_at). Any failure consumes no dispatch authority; do not edit the comment. An ACT-04-only expiry may be reissued by the unchanged ACT-04 actor only after current drift checks. Effective Phase-4 token expiry is different: while PR2 is open, stop and obtain a new exact VOC-085 settings-authority record plus replacement ACT03 before replacing only the environment-scoped API-token value and before PR2 merges. After PR2 merge, stop for a newly governed correction because the exact transition is stale. Never reuse, silently reissue, or mutate any other environment setting.
